# volcenginecc_billing_financial_relation (Data Source)

Data Source schema for Volcengine::Billing::FinancialRelation



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `account_alias` (String) Display name, used for page display to clarify account usage scenarios.
- `auth_info` (Attributes Set) Financial relationship authorization point. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth_info))
- `auth_list_str` (String) Authorization list, separated by commas. Permission points are as follows: 1 Allow sub-account to share contract discounts of the main account; 2 Allow main account to view the sub-account's fund balance; 3 Allow main account to allocate and reclaim credit limits for the sub-account; 4 Allow main account to view the sub-account's billing information; 5 Allow main account to assist the sub-account with invoice management.
- `cancel_invitation` (Boolean) Cancel authorization invitation. false: Do not cancel; true: Cancel. To initiate a new authorization invitation, please cancel the existing one first.
- `filiation` (Number) Main-sub relationship enumeration values. 1: Main; 2: Sub.
- `filiation_desc` (String) Description of main-sub relationship.
- `major_account_id` (Number) Main account UID.
- `major_account_name` (String) Main account name.
- `relation` (Number) Relationship type. Currently, only Enterprise Finance is supported: 1 Financial Custody; 4 Financial Management.
- `relation_desc` (String) Description of relationship type.
- `relation_id` (String) Relationship ID.
- `status` (Number) Financial relationship status enumeration values. 100: In progress; 200: Established; 250: Rejected; 300: Canceled; 400: Revoked; 500: Deleted (not visible on the page).
- `status_desc` (String) Description of financial relationship status.
- `sub_account_id` (String) Sub-account UID.
- `sub_account_name` (String) Sub-account name.
- `updated_time` (String) Update time.

<a id="nestedatt--auth_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth_info`

Read-Only:

- `auth_id` (String) Financial relationship authorization ID.
- `auth_list` (Set of Number) Authorization list, separated by commas. Permission points are as follows: 1 Allow sub-account to share contract discounts of the main account; 2 Allow main account to view the sub-account's fund balance; 3 Allow main account to allocate and reclaim credit limits for the sub-account; 4 Allow main account to view the sub-account's billing information; 5 Allow main account to assist the sub-account with invoice management.
- `auth_status` (Number) Authorization status enumeration values. 100: Authorization in progress; 200: Authorization established; 250: Authorization change rejected by sub-account; 300: Authorization change canceled by main account; 400: Authorization revoked.
